news.headline: Cloudflare Announces Date of Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: SAN FRANCISCO, October 13, 2026--Cloudflare, Inc. (NYSE: NET), the leading connectivity cloud company, today announced that it will report its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026 after the U.S. market closes on Thursday, November 5, 2026.

news.headline: FRUIT Introduces PAVE, an Approach to Bringing Human Judgment Into AI Systems
news.summary: As AI systems take on more work, PAVE introduces a way for human judgment, authority, and attribution to be represented within agentic systems.
